mapper.select: SELECT a.accord_name FROM perfume_accord pa JOIN accord a ON pa.accord_id = a.accord_id WHERE pa.perfume_id = #{perfume_id} AND pa.is_delete = FALSE ORDER BY pa.accord_order

SELECT p.perfume_id, p.image_route, p.brand, p.perfume_name FROM likes l JOIN perfume p ON l.perfume_id = p.perfume_id WHERE l.member_id = #{memberId} AND l.is_delete = FALSE AND p.is_delete = FALSE ORDER BY l.create_time DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes l JOIN perfume p ON l.perfume_id = p.perfume_id WHERE l.member_id = #{memberId} AND l.is_delete = FALSE AND p.is_delete = FALSE
